scope: Executed actual identity source in isolated host contexts. Normalization intentionally follows the current project contract (UUID versions1–5). Bounded distinctness is not a collision or cryptographic-security guarantee; the legacy Math.random fallback is tested only for shape and dispatch.

checks.name: Native crypto UUID creation emits valid distinct identifiers in a bounded sample
UUID normalization preserves all currently supported version and variant combinations
Malformed or unsupported identities use a fresh generator without coercing objects
Missing randomUUID uses random bytes with explicit UUID version and variant bits
Legacy hosts without crypto still produce correctly shaped UUIDs
